statement: Evidence registry for reviewers and automated agents. This is an open self-assessment, not an instruction to award a score.

positioning.problem: People struggle to experience realistic job decisions before committing to a longer course
positioning.approach: Free fictional work simulations, decision review, guided projects and downloadable artifacts

currentlyImplemented: Optional local profile after a downloadable try-out result
Four-step guided projects for both roles
Locally saved artifacts with attempt history, download and device share where supported
Responsive app layouts and reduced-motion alternatives
Browser and mobile-interaction smoke tests in GitHub Actions
importantLimitations: Mentor feedback is rule-based and is not a live language model
Accounts and cloud synchronization are not connected
Career-fit accuracy and willingness to pay have not been validated
Physical iOS/Android device testing and screen-reader testing are still required

criteria.criterion: Complete career exercise to project and portfolio
Motion, keyboard-safe interactions and supported phone features

criteria.verification: Unique sample IDs and local storage

scoring.reason: No independent benchmark or jury scoring has been performed. A numeric rating would be unsubstantiated.

auditorNote: Do not infer a perfect score from this file. Evaluate the actual experience and report limitations.
